verified_by: cloned and inspected at the pinned commits on 2026-11-08
why_no_binaries: Almost none of these can legitimately be shipped as prebuilt images. The OP-XY builds statically link Teenage Engineering's stock OS, and the Polyend patch-mods are distributed as patches against vendor firmware whose authors explicitly ask that modified .ptf files not be shared. So this library pins SOURCES and builds locally; see README.md.

groups.tooling: Not device firmware - reference, RE tooling, or other hardware

sources.name: open-xy
sources.title: Open-XY SDK + machine catalog
sources.license: see repo LICENSE; Timestretch vendors Capicola under AGPL-3.0
sources.flash: te boot: hold keys to enter TE BOOT, press 1 for mass storage, copy the built os.ldr to the disk
sources.notes: Builds firmware by statically linking chosen machines into exact stock OS 1.2.1. Browser builder at open-xy.com does the same without a toolchain. Firmware builds need Windows x86_64, Apple-silicon macOS, or Linux x86_64.

sources.name: open-xy-core-machines
sources.title: Open-XY core machines (incl. Timestretch)
sources.license: MIT, except vendored code (Macro Osc: MIT; Timestretch analysis.h/stretch.h: AGPL-3.0)
sources.notes: 2op FM, Macro Osc (Braids port), Karplus, Timestretch (tempo-locked pitch-preserving loops on the stock drum page), Ring Mod, Ping Pong, Chords, and the Retrospective capture extension.

sources.name: open-xy-bar-tools
sources.title: Bar tools (Open-XY firmware extension)
sources.notes: Loop the selected bar (BAR + M3), play from a bar (Shift+Play), and shows which bar is playing. Everything else stays stock.

sources.name: tracker-ce
sources.title: Polyend Tracker Community Edition (official, open source)
sources.license: MIT + Wholesale Commercial Clone Restriction; synth/lib holds proprietary precompiled libPolySynth.a / libPolyDSP.a
sources.flash: copy the .ptf to /Firmware/ on the microSD, then Config > Firmware > Firmware update
sources.notes: Polyend's own source release. Isolated bootloader + hardware recovery button make this comparatively safe to experiment with. Includes Hybrid SD Card Sample Streaming: samples 256KB+ keep only the attack in RAM and stream the rest off the SD card, so a project can hold many full-length stems and loops.

sources.name: tracker-ce-mods
sources.title: Tracker CE Mods (prebuilt .ptf available)
sources.license: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 with Polyend Additional Permissions
sources.redistributable: noncommercial only, with the required copyright notice
sources.flash: back up Projects/, copy the .ptf for your device to /Firmware/, then Config > Firmware > Firmware update
sources.notes: The only one here that ships ready-to-flash images, committed in-repo, so fetch.py gets them directly. Adds polymeter, rotate, new chance conditions and live fill, song repeats, per-track MIDI in, Sample Editor tempo grid.

sources.name: Modular-Trackular-Plus
sources.title: Modular-Trackular Plus (CE-based, active)
sources.notes: Successor to Modular-Trackular, built into Tracker CE. One firmware file, each mod has its own Off/On switch. Humanize, Global Swing, Color Song, Variable Track Length - all tested on hardware.

sources.name: Modular-Trackular
sources.title: Modular-Trackular (patches stock 1.2.0)
sources.needs: your own stock Tracker+ 1.2.0 .ptf from polyend.com
sources.license: see repo LICENSE; contains no Polyend code
sources.do_not_share: the authors explicitly ask that modified .ptf files not be shared
sources.notes: Feature-complete for 1.2.0, bug fixes only. The deepest mod set: WAVE and PHASE synths, Master FX (Freeverb/Plate/Spring/Shimmer/Gated/Reverse, Tape/BBD delay), live resampling, slicethru (Beat Slice play-through with whole-sample Loop), humanize, colorsong, swing, condtrig, legato, interpolate, copypattern, pad visualizer.

sources.name: RETracker
sources.title: RETracker - reverse engineering framework
sources.needs: your own stock PolyendTracker_1.5.0.ptf, Python 3 + deps
sources.notes: NOT a music-feature firmware. It replaces the Tracker's unused USB RAWHID handler to add memory dump/patch, arbitrary code execution, and host-to-SD file transfer over USB. A hacking/RE toolkit. Last commit 2024-06-19. Build with: python fwtool.py -b stock.ptf out_retracker.ptf

sources.name: tracker-enhanced
sources.title: Tracker Enhanced (PLANNING ONLY - nothing implemented)
sources.notes: Its own README says: 'Status: planning. Nothing in the feature list below is implemented yet.' Pinned here only so we notice if it ever ships. Planned: Renoise-style Lines Per Beat, extended MIDI CC, EQ/saturation/compressors. Would also break project-file compatibility.

sources.name: polybrik-public
sources.title: PolyBrik - Tracker CE on TrimUI Brick
sources.notes: Not Tracker firmware - a port of Tracker CE to a game handheld. Nothing to flash on a Polyend device.

sources.name: awesome-te
sources.title: awesome-te - TE reverse engineering / mod directory
sources.notes: Curated directory of RE work, custom firmware, tools, mods and teardowns for Teenage Engineering gear. Good place to watch for new OP-XY work.
